name: Office Affairs
source:
"Office Affairs" is an immersive visual novel game that takes players on an exciting journey through the complex world of office romance. As the protagonist, James, you find yourself caught in a whirlwind of relationships with your attractive coworkers, each with their own unique personality and captivating storylines. Navigate through a thrilling web of love, ambition, and personal growth as you juggle multiple love interests and strive for success in the professional realm.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2420520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《办公室事务》是一款沉浸式视觉小说游戏，带领玩家踏上复杂的办公室恋情世界的激动人心的旅程。作为主角詹姆斯，你发现自己陷入了与迷人同事的关系旋风中，每个人都有自己独特的个性和迷人的故事情节。当你兼顾多种爱情兴趣并努力在职业领域取得成功时，在爱情、野心和个人成长的惊心动魄的网络中航行。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2420520/]Steam[/url]]
